Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

Both a lawyer and a line cook had their bags searched at the airport. A drug-sniffing dog had signalled that officers should look into the bag of the lawyer and, sure enough, they found quite a bit of heroine. After the line cook's bag was flagged and searched, though, they were let go as it was apparently just a false alarm. Who was free of drugs?
A. Not known
B. The line cook
C. The lawyer
